# MYTH AI India

> MYTH AI India is an AI design studio and platform for India's fashion and textile industry: AI textile print and embroidery creation, seamless repeat development, 3D garment visualization, AI fashion collection development and AI catalog and campaign images. Delivered as Design as a Service (DaaS) from Rs 9,999 per month, or Agentic AI as a Service (AAaaS).

## Pages
- Services: DaaS and AAaaS
- Platform, Solutions (textile and apparel, D2C and retail, home textiles, export houses)
- Pricing, Academie, Resources and blog, About, Contact
